BiblicalUsage: Pârâ' occurs once: though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that fruitfulness without God dries fast: the east wind comes, and the spring that looked full is empty.
